class.name: HTMLNode
class.brief_description: A live DOM node owned by an HTML layout.

method.name: get_node_type
method.description: Returns the node's type, including for an invalidated handle.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the handle still refers to a node in its current layout.

method.name: is_connected
method.description: Returns whether the node is connected to its document tree. A detached node can stay valid.

method.name: get_parent_node
method.description: Returns the parent node, including a document or fragment. Returns [code]null[/code] for a root.

method.name: get_child_nodes
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the direct child nodes in tree order, including text and comments.

method.name: get_first_child
method.description: Returns the first direct child node, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_next_sibling
method.description: Returns the next sibling node, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_root_node
method.description: Returns the root of the current tree. A detached node may be its own root.

method.name: contains
method.description: Returns whether [param node] is this node or one of its descendants.

method.name: compare_document_position
method.description: Returns an OR of [enum DocumentPosition] flags describing the position of [param node] relative to this node.

method.name: is_equal_node
method.description: Compares node types, attributes, character data, and child nodes recursively.

method.name: normalize
method.description: Merges adjacent text nodes and detaches empty text nodes. The first nonempty text node retains its identity.

members.member: The slot assigned to this node, or null if no slot is assigned or its shadow root is closed.

The local modification revision of this logical node, starting at [code]1[/code]. Invalid handles return [code]0[/code]. Actual changes to attributes, character data, direct children, tree placement, and live form values advance this revision. Descendant edits, focus, hover, selections, scrolling, layout, and media playback progress do not. Repeated writes of the same value do not advance it. Detached nodes keep counting; text replacement and adoption preserve the logical revision, while clones start independently. Compare snapshots of the same node; revision differences are not an operation count or an ordering between nodes. This property is read-only and is not serialized.
